techniques.name: Sealing: Binding Tag
techniques.mechanic: Slap a sealing tag on a downed, stunned or bound enemy (needs item:sealing_tag): captured (a mission objective); bosses only bound 40 ticks
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Sealing: Four-Tag Barrier
techniques.mechanic: Throw four tags around an area (radius 4): a barrier wall for 200 ticks that nobody crosses (protect or trap)
techniques.counters: Lightning Blade or a spiralling sphere breaks it; the tags can be shot down

techniques.name: Sealing: Storage Scroll Barrage
techniques.mechanic: Unroll a storage scroll: up to 20 stored weapons rain from above in a 4-block circle (uses your kunai and shuriken from it)
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Sealing: Chakra Suppression
techniques.mechanic: A palm seal: the target cannot weave for 80 ticks (chakra sealed)
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Sealing: Five Elements Seal
techniques.mechanic: Five fingertips of fire: the target's nature jutsu are sealed for 400 ticks (taijutsu and genjutsu still work)
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles

techniques.name: Sealing: Marked Teleport
techniques.mechanic: Throw a marked kunai (up to 3 marks): press Weave to teleport to any mark in sight, instantly
techniques.counters: dodge or interrupt the signs; walls block projectiles
